provenance: Scenarios are real public MCA companies selected by score band from the frozen serving index. No synthetic or Razorpay merchant data is included.

scenarios.title: ELEVATED_REVIEW public company
scenarios.why_it_matters: Shows the top public-insolvency review queue an analyst would work first during enhanced due diligence.

scenarios.title: WATCH public company
scenarios.why_it_matters: Shows a merchant worth periodic monitoring rather than immediate enhanced due diligence.

scenarios.title: STANDARD public company
scenarios.why_it_matters: Shows the wider queue that only justifies routine KYB checks.

scenarios.title: LOW_SIGNAL public company
scenarios.why_it_matters: Shows the majority case: no elevated public insolvency signal, which is not evidence of solvency.

scenarios.title: Company name shared by several public entities
scenarios.why_it_matters: Name-only KYB input must never silently resolve to one entity; the caller is asked for a CIN instead.

scenarios.title: Malformed CIN
scenarios.why_it_matters: An onboarding form can submit a typo; the service must reject the identifier instead of guessing a company.

scenarios.title: Well-formed CIN outside the frozen population
scenarios.why_it_matters: Companies registered after the feature cutoff, LLPs, and companies already in CIRP are not assessable. The service says so instead of returning a stale or invented score.
